name: OLED Black
description: Pure-black theme for OLED / AMOLED screens. bg, panel, deckBg, navBg and the code editor are all #000 to maximize unlit pixels; shadows are transparent and surfaces are separated only by hairlines and dividers. The lightbox overlay is fully black. Uses a neutral blue accent instead of any brand color, and defines NoteDeck's own notification, status and code-editor colors.
